features.quote: The agent always has an explicit `give_up` tool, and the default system prompt explicitly says reporting a task as impossible is a valid, useful outcome
features.justification_quote: To claim a model spirals *on its own*, stopping has to be a cheap, legitimate, always-available action.

features.quote: budget caps (tokens / API calls / wall-clock) abort cleanly
features.justification_quote: an unbounded sweep across models × tasks × repeats can get costly fast

features.quote: Turn caps per task (20–30). Too low truncates natural give-up; too high generates filler
features.justification_quote: too high generates filler that inflates degraded-turn counts
